scientific_integrity.domain: Complex normal projective toric varieties of stable-set polytopes of simple even cycles of length at least 6.
scientific_integrity.limits: Reduced singular locus and generic transverse germs only; nongeneric local germs and scheme structure are not classified.
scientific_integrity.originality_risk: The 1996 general Wagner treatment was inspected only by abstract; it examines local rings and is a material residual risk for an equivalent specialization.
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: All even lengths; total unimodularity, feasibility of incidence circuits, toric normal-slice identification, and lattice polytope volume arguments.

title: Non-pure singular strata and intersection degrees for even-cycle stable-set toric varieties
